title.en: Materials, changes, life, time and light: an overview

text.en:
Asha asked how a seed grows, why iron rusts and how light travels.
"This book will answer those," said her teacher.

Science explores many questions. We study the properties of materials, such as hardness and shine, and how materials change, such as ice melting or iron rusting.
We study life processes like eating, breathing and growing in living things, how we measure time with clocks and pendulums, and the nature of light, which travels in straight lines and forms shadows.
These ideas link: light helps plants grow, heat changes materials, and time measures how fast things happen.
